notes: Not every complaint is about a person. Open Complaints, tap Raise a complaint, and General now sits at the top of the About list — pick it when the issue is with a policy, a facility or the workplace itself rather than a colleague. It reaches HR by exactly the same confidential route a named complaint takes, and it reads as General everywhere a name would otherwise appear, instead of naming somebody who was never involved. For HR, the CEO, the MD and the Backend, a complaint can now be cleared once it is finished with: open it from the Complaints inbox and Delete sits beside Save for anything already resolved or dismissed. It asks first, takes the resolution note with it, and cannot be undone — an audit entry recording who removed it, and when, is all that is left. A complaint that is still open or under review can never be deleted, and neither can one raised against you, however it was closed.
